name: B10-0437/2025 (S&D) – United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text:
The European Parliament says Russia is deliberately testing the EU with drones and fighter jets entering its airspace, and it wants a united answer. It asks member states to build a shared air defence system, invest more in defence, and expand drone and anti-drone production. It wants Europe to work closely with NATO, keep supporting Ukraine, and protect critical infrastructure like airports and undersea cables. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks for joint air defence, more defence spending and a drone package.
- **Who it affects:** EU member states, their armed forces and defence industries, and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** Member states and the Commission are urged to act; no timeline is set.
